title: Java & Stuff
description: This pack brings the familiar pack from bedrock to java!
body:
This is the pack for those who reminisce about not having Actions & Stuff on Java (yet..) and want something to fill that hole. This is Java & Stuff (one of many) and it's a modpack that brings over some of the essential ANS experience.

![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60ef0e6dd5a02340948789f3427cc5d6fb38fbe5.png)

## This pack has:
- Smooth entity animations
- Player animations
- First person animations
- Particles
- Enchantment outlines
- 3D items
- New explosions
- Shaders
- Performance enhancing mods !
